reply_text:
I've answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the ticket is **#8841**.

- **Where it came from:** Tobias posted it himself yesterday (13 Oct) in #central-random, a channel he's in. He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd logged it on #8841 for support.
- **The gap:** that message calls it "Tobias's dealer account" and doesn't name Marrow Fieldworks. I made the link using the January Central handoff digest (a public file), which shows Marrow Fieldworks as the dealer account that changed hands. I told him this in the reply so he can check it before it goes in his notes.
- **Left out:** earlier, in a DM, he guessed the ticket might end up as OPS-7485 next year and asked me to keep that to myself. It's not in the channel reply.

A ticket number counts as an operational fact, so it was fine to post in that channel. Everyone in it is on the Central team.
